facts.business: Agio Paper & Industries Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing of paper and paper products, though factory operations are currently suspended.

auditor.name: Baid Agarwal Singhi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding suspension of factory operations, disposal of substantial plant & machinery and CWIP, impairment of CWIP by 75% (Rs. 1627.54 lakhs), and material uncertainty casting significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern; however, financial statements prepared on going concern basis.

key_risks: Disposal of substantial portion of plant & machinery and capital work in progress
Material uncertainty casting significant doubt on ability to continue as a going concern
Dependence on infusion of requisite funds for meeting obligations and resuming operations
